patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I get this sharp stab when I breathe in and I'm weirdly short of breath. My right calf's been sore and swollen for a few days. I'm on the pill and I just got back from a long flight.
presentation.triageNote: 28-year-old female taking oral contraceptives after a recent long-haul flight. She has sharp pain on inspiration, shortness of breath, heart rate 118, oxygen saturation 93%, and a swollen tender right calf.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, tachycardia, hypoxemia, and unilateral calf swelling create a high-risk thromboembolic presentation.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This young adult has acute cardiopulmonary symptoms plus estrogen use, recent prolonged travel, and a swollen tender right calf.
clinical.acuityReason: The combined symptoms and risk factors require rapid assessment for pulmonary vascular obstruction despite preserved blood pressure.
expectedResources: CT pulmonary angiography or alternative definitive imaging
keyFindings: Oral contraceptive use and recent long flight
redFlags: Hypoxemia with pleuritic pain and unilateral leg swelling
teachingPoints: The leg examination and risk-factor history can reveal the source of an otherwise nonspecific cardiopulmonary complaint.
Normal blood pressure does not exclude clinically important pulmonary vascular obstruction.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Rapid imaging and risk stratification would guide anticoagulation and determine whether monitored admission or selected outpatient treatment is appropriate.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting upright, one hand on her chest, breathing shallowly
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 28-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting upright, one hand pressed to her chest, breathing shallowly, one lower leg extended showing a swollen calf. Expression: anxious and short of breath. Clearly visible: a hand on the chest and one visibly swollen calf. No text, no logos.
